style_profile.name: Tactile Tech Unboxing & Accessory Assembly ASMR
style_profile.hook_strategy: Direct top-down unboxing starting with acoustic tapping on shopping bag, fast unboxing box pull, and immediate reveal of the sleek product on a clean white diffused studio setup.
style_profile.preferred_font_layout: Bold clean centered title badge on hook ('Product Unboxing'), followed by zero subtitle overlay during hands-on assembly to keep full focus on product textures and acoustic ASMR.
transition_rules: Step-by-step modular micro-cuts synced directly to physical tactile actions (pull-tab tear, screen peel, alcohol wipe, glass snap, case fit)
Macro top-down lock-in camera angles with subtle dynamic push-in on power-on and finish reveals

learned_novel_effects.description: Smooth lateral camera drift tracking the exact motion of peeling a package security pull-tab.
Instant micro camera snap perfectly aligned with the mechanical click of snapping on a protective lens or case.
Slow majestic push-in capturing the illumination of a fresh OLED display greeting screen.
Slow majestic camera push-in tracking an ultra-satisfying continuous adhesive film peeling motion.
Instant high-energy snap transition contrasting filthy caked grime against factory-fresh pristine texture.
Smooth dynamic macro camera drift showcasing the virgin, immaculate surface finish.
